test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options correctly lists the composition of the State Executive in India?

options.text: Governor, Chief Minister and Council of Ministers
Governor, Deputy Minister and State Council of Advisors
Governor, Chief Minister and State Legislative Assembly members

solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor, Chief Minister and Council of Ministers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The State Executive** in India is composed of the **Governor, Chief Minister, and Council of Ministers**. These bodies collectively function to govern the state and implement policies and programs.
 
• **Governor:** The Governor is the constitutional head of the state and represents the President of India at the state level. The Governor ensures the state's administration aligns with constitutional provisions and provides assent to bills passed by the state legislature.
 
• **Chief Minister:** The Chief Minister is the head of the government in the state. They act as the executive leader of the state, responsible for implementing policies and ensuring the smooth functioning of the state administration.
 
• **Council of Ministers:** The Council of Ministers assists the Chief Minister in decision-making and policy implementation. They hold portfolios such as education, health, agriculture, and finance, ensuring comprehensive governance across all sectors.
 
• These three components work together under a parliamentary system of governance at the state level, ensuring that decisions are made democratically and implemented effectively.
 
• **Incorrect Options:**
 
 
• Option 2 includes the President, which is incorrect as the President is the head of state for the nation, not part of the state executive.
 
• Option 3 mentions Deputy Ministers and State Council of Advisors, which are not part of the official composition of the state executive.
 
• Option 4 refers to State Legislative Assembly members, who are part of the legislative branch, not the executive branch.
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Governor, Chief Minister, and Council of Ministers.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Governor:**

 
 
• The **Governor** is appointed by the President of India and serves as the constitutional head of the state. They act as a link between the state and the central government.
 
• The Governor’s responsibilities include granting assent to bills, appointing the Chief Minister, and dissolving the state legislative assembly during emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister:**
 
 
• The **Chief Minister** is the elected leader of the majority party in the state legislative assembly. They are responsible for forming the Council of Ministers and advising the Governor.
 
• The Chief Minister represents the state at the national level and plays a crucial role in policy formulation and implementation.
 
 
 
• **Council of Ministers:**
 
 
• The **Council of Ministers** is composed of ministers responsible for various departments. They help the Chief Minister in executing policies and managing the state’s administration.
 
• These ministers are collectively responsible to the state legislature and work under the guidance of the Chief Minister.
 
 
 
• **State Executive Functions:**
 
 
• The state executive ensures the implementation of laws passed by the state legislature and delivers governance to the citizens of the state.
 
• It plays a vital role in maintaining law and order, promoting economic growth, and ensuring social welfare programs are effectively executed.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Governor’s Role:**

 
 
• The Governor acts as a guardian of the Constitution within the state, ensuring that the state government functions within constitutional limits.
 
• The Governor has the power to summon and dissolve the state legislative assembly, appoint the Chief Minister, and oversee the implementation of central policies in the state.
 
 
 
• **Chief Minister’s Role:**
 
 
• The Chief Minister leads the Council of Ministers and is primarily responsible for policy decisions, budget preparation, and coordination among various departments.
 
• They act as the representative of the state in national matters and ensure the state's development aligns with the central government’s goals.
 
 
 
• **Council of Ministers’ Role:**
 
 
• The Council of Ministers manages specific portfolios and ensures the implementation of policies, programs, and projects for the state’s growth and development.
 
• They are collectively responsible to the state legislature and play a crucial role in decision-making processes.
